cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: the open side door of a camper van parked by a lake at night — perched on a ledge or edge; a medieval guild workshop — holds her keepsake at chest height; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — loops the strap of a camera over her head; the top of a restored ancient city wall — standing; a western coastal signal tower with an open gallery and a large brass viewing telescope on a fixed stand — she is a signal-keeper taking a break after looking through the telescope; her crew cabin aboard a starship — holds a book closed against her chest; a night river covered with floating paper lanterns — kneeling on the ground; an esports arena — rests a pair of inflatable cheering sticks against her shoulder; a penthouse window wall over the city at night — rests a cup on her knee; the upper balcony of a wooden pavilion with upturned eaves — sets a small hand lantern down on the ground beside her; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — sitting on the ground; terraced tea fields on a misty Sichuan hillside — lying on her front; a city station platform or the inside of a commuter train — standing
